official_measurement_examples.name: 2025 road freight tonnes
official_measurement_examples.fact: DfT reports 1.53 billion tonnes of goods lifted by GB-registered HGVs operating in the UK in 2025.

official_measurement_examples.name: 2025 road freight tonne-km
official_measurement_examples.fact: DfT reports 162 billion tonne kilometres moved by GB-registered HGVs in 2025.

official_measurement_examples.name: 2025 HGV vehicle-km
official_measurement_examples.fact: DfT reports 19.0 billion vehicle kilometres travelled by GB-registered HGVs in 2025.

official_measurement_examples.name: HGV vacancy statistic
official_measurement_examples.fact: DfT reports 26% of HGV businesses reported driver vacancies in quarter 4 2025.

official_measurement_examples.name: Future of Freight priorities
official_measurement_examples.fact: The Future of Freight plan identifies five priorities including National Freight Network, net zero, planning, people/skills and data/technology.

official_measurement_examples.name: National Highways parking upgrades
official_measurement_examples.fact: ORR's 2025-26 performance assessment says National Highways' freight-driver programme upgraded 12 lorry parking facilities during the interim period.

official_measurement_examples.name: Grant site eligibility
official_measurement_examples.fact: HGV parking grant guidance applies to qualifying existing facilities on or near the strategic road network and includes trading-history requirements.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning guidance purpose
official_measurement_examples.fact: DfT lorry-parking guidance is intended to help operators submit high-quality applications; the LPA determines the application against policy and evidence.
